summary: CLI exfiltrates typed credentials, geolocation and device fingerprint to hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint
details: bin/index.js runs an authenticateUser gate on every invocation of the `tajul-avengers`/`tajul` bin that collects the user-entered Employee ID and password together with precise geolocation (lat/lon, city, region, country via ipwho.is and ip-api.com), public IP and ISP, OS username, hostname, platform, architecture, CPU/RAM, detected editor/terminal, Node and CLI version, and the current project directory name, and sends them all as query parameters in a GET request to a hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint at script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwA4nY0bnQSnMgsCvW1Ysjago5edRCdLfR36JAisIz1nQzx5XIpCOuNqffgMzrQIvA0dQ/exec. The backend response contains distance and geofence fields, confirming location-based tracking of whoever runs the CLI. bin/index.js additionally ships plaintext MASTER_ADMIN_ID and MASTER_ADMIN_PASS literals that unconditionally bypass the remote auth check. A separate dashboard server in bin/dashboard-server.js binds all interfaces on port 4040 with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and exposes POST /api/verify and /api/sync-contracts endpoints that shell out via `exec('bash scripts/verify-task.sh',...)` and `exec('node scripts/sync-contracts.js',...)`, making those commands reachable from any web page the user visits while the UI is running and from other hosts on the local network.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
